description: Ministry of Public Administration, Management & Law & Order - 5th Amendment to the service minute of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service
reasoning: This gazette notification contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, specifically detailing promotion procedures, qualifications, and interview processes for public service officers. It falls under Public Service Gazettes as it deals with public service recruitment, promotion criteria, and administrative procedures within the government service sector, without involving government structural changes, specific personnel appointments with portfolios, or other specialized categories.
